title: Conflict Between Chinese Soldiers And Japanese Marines

G. 1. 45-1-31.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT

File No.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Special Branch Registry
No. S. B. D. 2657
Date 6 August 1931.

Subject (in full) Conflict between Chinese Soldiers and Japanese Marines.

Made by and JPP Forwarded by C. D. I. Robertson.

With reference to the above subject on which
articles have appeared in the Intelligence Report of
August 3 and August 5 and on which reports made by
D.S.I. Widdowson and J.D.S. Umemoto are attached showing
the result of investigations made by these two officers
and in order to elucidate matters, I have to point out
the various sources of information through which the
Intelligence on the case was obtained.

The information contained in the Intelligence
Reports of August 3 was furnished by an Agent of S. 1
who in turn received it from a policeman of the Public
Safety Bureau stationed at Jessfield Village. This
information was also verified by the Public Safety Bureau
through Supt. Tan Shao-liang. The information contained in
the Intelligence Report of August 5 was furnished as the
result of further inquiries made by the Agent of S. 1
and also from information contained in J.D.S. Umemoto's
report of August 4. D.S.I. Widdowson's report
dated August 3 is based on information received from the
Special Branch and from Lieutenant Sakaguchi, i/c Japanese
Marines stationed at the Toyoda Mill, Jessfield Road and
the information contained in the report furnished by
J.D.S. Umemoto is the result of an interview with Major
Tomosada, Staff Officer of the Japanese Landing Forces.

Therefore the details of the affairs as recorded
in the Intelligence Reports may be said to be a fairly
accurate account of what actually happened.

Ray
7/8
Officer i/c Special Branch.
Fib 7.8.1931

Henry Robertson
C. D. I.
A.B. (Crime)
Information and form
of return 6:8:31

报告

档案编号。
上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别股登记处
编号 S. B. D. 2657
日期 1931年8月6日。

主题（全称）中国士兵与日本海军陆战队之间的冲突。

制表人 JPP 转呈人 C. D. I. Robertson。

关于上述主题，8月3日和8月5日的《情报报告》中已刊登相关文章，并附有副督察 Widdowson 和日本侦探警员 Umemoto 所作的报告，显示了这两名官员的调查结果。为了阐明事实，我必须指出本案情报是通过各种来源获得的。

8月3日《情报报告》中所载的情报由 S. 1 组的一名线人提供，该线人又是从驻极司菲尔村（Jessfield Village）的公安局警察处获得此信息。该信息也通过谭绍良（Tan Shao-liang）巡长经公安局核实。8月5日《情报报告》中所载的情报是 S. 1 组线人进一步查询的结果，同时也来自日本侦探警员 Umemoto 8月4日报告中的信息。副督察 Widdowson 8月3日的报告基于从特别股以及驻极司菲尔路丰田纱厂（Toyoda Mill）的日本海军陆战队负责人坂口（Sakaguchi）中尉处获得的信息；而日本侦探警员 Umemoto 提供的报告中所载信息，则是采访日本登陆部队参谋友定（Tomosada）少校的结果。

因此，《情报报告》中记录的事件细节可以说是对实际发生情况的相当准确的描述。

Ray
7/8
特别股负责人。
Fib 7.8.1931

Henry Robertson
刑事调查主任 (C. D. I.)
A.B. (犯罪科)

page_data.en:
Extract from the Intelligence Report of August 3, 1931.
------------------------------------------------------------

Conflict between Chinese and Japanese soldiers

At 10 a.m. August 1, eight soldiers of the 3rd Company,
1st Battalion, 27th Regiment, 13th Brigade, 5th Division,
stationed at the San King Miao, Jessfield, on patrol
duty on Jessfield Road, arrived in front of the Toyoda
Mill, 200 Jessfield Road, and were prevented from proceeding
further by three Japanese marines stationed at the mill
premises. Followed by the three Japanese marines the
soldiers withdrew to Chung San Road, where they attempted
to disarm the marines who promptly loaded their firearms
and prepared to defend themselves. On seeing this,
the Chinese soldiers desisted whereupon the marines withdrew
to return to the scene some few minutes later with
reinforcements who, it is reported, were equipped with a
machine gun. On the approach of the marines the soldiers
retreated quickly and sought refuge in the San Kying
Cotton Mill, Jessfield, whereupon the marines returned
to the Toyoda Mill.
page_data.zh:
1931年8月3日《情报报告》摘录。
------------------------------------------------------------

中日士兵之间的冲突

8月1日上午10时，驻扎在极司菲尔三官庙（San King Miao）的第五师第十三旅第二十七团第一营第三连的八名士兵，在极司菲尔路执行巡逻任务时，到达极司菲尔路200号的丰田纱厂门前，被三名驻扎在厂区内的日本海军陆战队员阻止继续前进。在这三名日本海军陆战队员的跟随下，士兵们撤退至中山路（Chung San Road），在那里他们试图解除陆战队员的武装，后者迅速给枪支上膛并准备自卫。中国士兵见此情形便停止了行动，随后陆战队员撤回，但几分钟后带着增援部队返回现场，据报道增援部队配备了一挺机枪。随着陆战队员的逼近，士兵们迅速撤退，并在极司菲尔的三庆棉纺厂（San Kying Cotton Mill）寻求庇护，随后陆战队员返回丰田纱厂。

page_data.en:
Extract from the Intelligence Report of August 5, 1931.
------------------------------------------------------------

    With reference to the occurence between Chinese
soldiers and Japanese marines vide Intelligence Report
of August 3, it has now been verified that one of the
Japanese marines received a small bayonet wound in the
left arm at the hands of one of the Chinese soldiers.
It also appears that at 10 a.m. August 1, an officer
attached to the 5th Division called on the officer
in command of the marines stationed at the Toyoda Mill
and apologised for the incident. His visit was followed
by an officer attached to the Public Safety Bureau who
discussed the matter with the Japanese Authorities.

    In view of the apology tendered by the Chinese Authori-
ties the commander of the Japanese Landing Forces has de-
cided not to regard the matter seriously.
page_data.zh:
1931年8月5日《情报报告》摘录。
------------------------------------------------------------

    关于中国士兵与日本海军陆战队之间发生的事件（参见8月3日《情报报告》），现已核实，其中一名日本海军陆战队员被一名中国士兵用刺刀刺伤左臂，伤口轻微。此外，8月1日上午10时，第五师的一名军官拜访了驻扎在丰田纱厂的海军陆战队指挥官，并就此次事件表示歉意。随后，公安局的一名军官也到访，并与日本当局讨论了此事。

    鉴于中国当局已表示歉意，日本登陆部队指挥官决定不将此事件视为严重问题。

Form No. 2
G. 21,800-1-31

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

File No. _______

REPORT

Section 2. Special
Date August 4, 1931.

Subject (in full) Conflict between Chinese and Japanese Soldiers.

Made by J.D.S. Umemoto. Forwarded by

Acting upon your instructions, I called on Major
Tomosada, the Staff Officer, at the Headquarters of the Japanese
Landing Force, and received from him the following information
regarding the conflict between Chinese soldiers and Japanese
marines on August 1, 1931.

At 8.30 a.m. August 1, 1931 a sentinel at the
watch-tower of the Toyoda Cotton Mill, 200 Jessfield Road, report-
ed to the Officer in command of Japanese marines stationed there
that a number of about 10 Chinese soldiers, marching along the
railway, had entered into Jessfield Road and were proceeding
towards the Mill. Three marines were ordered to prevent them
from proceeding further. When the soldiers were told not to
march along the Municipal road, they quickly withdrew, being
followed by one of the marines. Upon arriving at the junction
of Jessfield Road and the Railway, they fixed bayonets and
threatened to attack him. After a while one of them attempted
to disarm him who was at this time standing at attention and
inflicted on his arm a stab wound of 5m.m. wide and 3m.m. deep.
In the meantime four marines under a section commander rushed to
the scene, whereupon the soldiers dispersed.

Major Tomosada further stated that at 10 a.m.
August 1, 31 an officer of the 5th Division called on the Officer
in Command at the Mill and offered an apology for the incident,
and that later an officer of the Public Safety Bureau came to the
Mill and returned after some discussions over the incident.

In view of the fact that an apology was offered
by the Chinese, the Commander of the Japanese Landing Force does
not desire to regard the matter seriously.

J.D.S. M. Umemoto

Officer i/c Special Branch.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。

档案编号 _______

报告

第2部分。特别股
日期 1931年8月4日。

主题（全称）中日士兵之间的冲突。

制表人 J.D.S. Umemoto。转呈人

遵照您的指示，我拜访了日本登陆部队司令部的参谋友定（Tomosada）少校，并从他那里获得了关于1931年8月1日中国士兵与日本海军陆战队之间冲突的以下信息。

1931年8月1日上午8时30分，极司菲尔路200号丰田棉纺厂瞭望塔的一名哨兵向驻扎在那里的日本海军陆战队指挥官报告称，约有10名中国士兵沿铁路行进，已进入极司菲尔路并向纱厂方向推进。三名陆战队员受命阻止他们继续前进。当被告知不得在工部局道路上行进时，士兵们迅速撤退，其中一名陆战队员跟随其后。当到达极司菲尔路与铁路的交汇处时，他们装上刺刀并威胁要攻击他。过了一会儿，其中一人试图解除当时立正站立的陆战队员的武装，并在其手臂上造成一处宽5毫米、深3毫米的刺伤。与此同时，四名由一名分队长率领的陆战队员赶到现场，士兵们随即散去。

友定少校进一步表示，1931年8月1日上午10时，第五师的一名军官拜访了纱厂的指挥官，并就此次事件表示歉意，随后公安局的一名军官来到纱厂，就此事进行了一些讨论后离开。

鉴于中方已表示歉意，日本登陆部队指挥官不希望将此事件视为严重问题。

J.D.S. M. Umemoto

特别股负责人。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Station Reference No. 25.
REPORT

File No.__________
Bubbling Well
Station,
Date August 3rd, 1931.

Subject (in full) Trouble between Japanese Marines and Chinese Military.

Made by D. S. I. Widdowson. Forwarded by H. Stibbe Insp

Sir,
Acting on receipt of information from C.D.I. Robertson, on
the 3/8/31, enquiries were made regarding a reported collision
between Japanese Marines and Chinese Soldiers, on Jessfield Road.
Lieut. Sakaguchi, i/c of the Japanese Marines Stationed at the
Toyoda Mill, Jessfield Road, states that a full report has been
submitted to the Japanese Consular Authorities, and he was unable
to supply more than the following brief details.
At about 8.40 a.m. the 2/8/31, a detachment of about
10 Chinese Soldiers crossed the Jessfield Railway Bridge(over
the Soochow Creek) from the North, to the South side. They then
marched West, along Jessfield Road, over Chung San Road, to the
entrance of the Toyoda Mill, which is about 50 yds. West of
Chung San Road. There they were stopped by 3 Japanese Marine
Guards, on duty at the Mill, who advised them to retrace their
steps. They retreated to Chung San Road, followed by the
Japanese Marines. Arrived there the Chinese loaded, and levelled
their rifles at the Japanese, and one Japanese received a
bayonet thrust through the left arm, and is now detained in
Hospital.
The Chinese then retreated South along Chung San Road,
towards Ziccawei. Lieut. Sakaguchi would give no reason for
their retirement, or any explanation of any action taken by his
men other than the above, referring us to the Japanese Naval
Headquarters.
Subsequently, we are informed, a guard of Chinese
troops fully armed, were placed on guard at the junction of
Jessfield Road and the Railway Bridge, and for several hours
from midnight 2/3-8-31, all Westbound traffic was halted. So

（左侧手写批注：C. Commr 4/8/31）

分局参考编号 25。
报告

档案编号__________
静安寺
分局，
日期 1931年8月3日。

主题（全称）日本海军陆战队与中国军队之间的纠纷。

制表人 D. S. I. Widdowson。转呈人 H. Stibbe 巡官

先生，
根据1931年8月3日从刑事调查主任 Robertson 处收到的信息，我们就极司菲尔路上据报道发生的日本海军陆战队与中国士兵之间的冲突进行了查询。驻极司菲尔路丰田纱厂的日本海军陆战队负责人坂口（Sakaguchi）中尉表示，已向日本领事当局提交了完整报告，他除了提供以下简要细节外，无法提供更多信息。
1931年8月2日上午8时40分左右，约10名中国士兵组成的小分队从北面穿过极司菲尔铁路桥（跨越苏州河）到达南面。然后他们沿极司菲尔路向西行进，经过中山路，到达位于中山路以西约50码处的丰田纱厂入口。在那里，他们被三名在纱厂执勤的日本海军陆战队卫兵拦住，卫兵建议他们原路返回。他们退至中山路，日本海军陆战队员紧随其后。到达那里后，中国人给步枪上膛，并将枪口对准日本人，一名日本人的左臂被刺刀刺穿，目前正在医院留治。
随后，中国人沿中山路向南撤退，朝徐家汇（Ziccawei）方向而去。坂口中尉未说明他们撤退的原因，也未对其部下采取的任何行动作出除上述内容以外的任何解释，而是让我们去咨询日本海军司令部。
此后，我们获悉，全副武装的中国军队卫兵被部署在极司菲尔路与铁路桥的交汇处执勤，从1931年8月2/3日午夜起数小时内，所有西行交通均被阻断。所以

（左侧手写批注：C. Commr 4/8/31）

page_data.en:
August 7, 1931. Afternoon Translation.
(Continuation)

CHINESE SOLDIER STABS JAPANESE MARINE OF DUTY IN
WESTERN DISTRICT

The Shanghai Nippo (6-8-M)
publishes the following report:-
At 8 a.m. August 1, a
Japanese marine corporal, named S. Uematsu, on duty
patrolling the Western District near the Toyoda Cotton
Mill, observed 10 Chinese soldiers entering the district
under his care. He succeeded in chasing them out of
his district towards Doxan Road when another Chinese
soldier, who had followed them, suddenly emerged from
a Chinese crowd and stabbed the Japanese marine from
behind in his arm with his bayonet causing serious
injury. At this moment, a Japanese Special Sub-
Lieutenant, named Sakaguchi, accompanied by 4 marines,
who were patrolling that locality, rushed to assist the
stabbed Marine whereupon the Chinese soldier ran away
together with the other ten. The incident attracted
a great crowd of Chinese as it occurred near to Chinese
territory.

Considering this incident as very serious
the Japanese marine authorities on August 2, lodged a strong
protest with the Public Safety Bureau against the soldiers.
The matter was settled by the Public Safety Bureau
tendering an apology to the Japanese marine authorities.
The Chinese authorities further explained that they

华兵在西区刺伤执勤日本海军陆战队员

《上海日报》（6-8-M）刊登如下报道：-
8月1日上午8时，一名名叫S. Uematsu的日本海军陆战队下士，在丰田棉纺厂附近的西区执行巡逻任务时，发现有10名中国士兵进入其管辖区域。他成功将他们逐出辖区，朝道契路（Doxan Road）方向追去。此时，另一名尾随他们的中国士兵突然从华人人群中冲出，用刺刀从背后刺伤了该名日本海军陆战队员的手臂，造成重伤。此刻，一名名叫坂口（Sakaguchi）的日本海军特别少尉， accompanied by 4名正在该地巡逻的海军陆战队员， rushed to assist the被刺的海军陆战队员，随后该中国士兵与其他十人一同逃窜。由于事发地点靠近中国地界，此事吸引了大量华人围观。

鉴于此事极为严重，日本海军当局于8月2日向公安局提出强烈抗议，针对涉事士兵。此事以公安局向日本海军当局致歉而告终。中方当局进一步解释称，他们已要求中国军事官员派遣士兵前往上述地点，旨在镇压共产主义活动并协助

Conflict between Chinese and Japanese soldiers

At 10 a.m. August 1, eight soldiers of the 3rd Company,
1st Battalion, 37th Regiment, 13th Brigade 5th Division,
stationed at the San Ling Rise, Joenfield, on patrol
duty on Joenfield road, arrived in front of the Japanese
Army, 206 Joenfield Road, and were prevented from proceeding
further by the Chinese soldiers stationed at the wall.

中日士兵冲突

8月1日上午10时，驻防于江湾（Joenfield）三岭坡（San Ling Rise）的第五师第十三旅第三十七团第一营第三连的八名士兵，在江湾路执行巡逻任务时，抵达江湾路206号日本陆军部队门前，被驻扎在围墙处的中国士兵阻止继续前进。

杂项 (3)

士兵撤退至长三路（Chang San Road），在那里他们试图解除海军陆战队员的武装，后者迅速给步枪上膛并准备自卫。□□在此期间，中国士兵部署了一个机枪连返回现场，几分钟后又有增援部队赶到，据报装备有一挺机枪。□□随着海军陆战队员的逼近，士兵们迅速撤退，躲入双兴寺山（Sun Sying Temple Hills），幸运的是，随后海军陆战队员返回了常规高地。
